description: Department of Local Government Northern Province - Notice for Meeting under the Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act. No. 22 of 2012
reasoning: This gazette notice announces a meeting for the election to fill a vacancy (Vice Chairman) in a local government body (Vavuniya South Tamil Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
